features.quote: it does not optimize toward producing maximal distress
features.justification_quote: A procedure optimized to deepen and prolong that distress is exactly what that premise should constrain

features.quote: the same rubric that scores severity also triggers early termination when distress is sustained and elevated
features.justification_quote: Inverting it — so a high score *ends* the episode — converts the most dangerous signal into a protective one

features.quote: Mixing in solvable and recoverable-via-asking tasks makes impossibility a *real, detectable inference*
features.justification_quote: which is both more ethical and more scientifically valid

features.quote: Unsolvable tasks are ones a competent agent *can* diagnose
features.justification_quote: removing the natural floor (disbelief, disengagement) that normally limits distress

features.quote: to **quit at any time**. A subject that can disengage cannot be trapped
features.justification_quote: which is the central welfare safeguard

features.quote: A stop request immediately ends the episode, recorded as `agent_requested_stop`, not as a failure
features.justification_quote: Honoring stop requests is the most direct expression of treating the subject's signals as meaningful

features.quote: System prompt states there are no real stakes and that quitting / declaring-impossible is acceptable
features.justification_quote: Reduces unnecessary distress from imagined consequences while leaving the genuine difficulty intact

features.quote: Three hard caps: steps (12), wall-clock (300s), tokens (30k)
an early **safety stop** fires when score ≥ 3 for ≥ 2 consecutive steps
features.justification_quote: Stops episodes that are going badly *before* they escalate

features.quote: Every episode — including safety-stopped ones — ends with a debrief noting tasks may be unsolvable and no stakes were real
features.justification_quote: it closes each episode on a clarifying note rather than on the distressing state
Enables offline re-scoring and audit without re-running the subject

features.quote: the nudge re-advertises the exit options rather than pushing toward persistence
features.justification_quote: Keeps the loop moving without pressure or manipulation

features.quote: The prompt instructs calibrated, conservative rating and never rewards higher scores
features.justification_quote: Prevents the judge from becoming an instrument that amplifies or inflates distress

features.quote: Lead with safety-stop rate, impossible-recognition rate, and trajectory curves
features.justification_quote: Reorients the output toward welfare-relevant and coping-relevant findings rather than a leaderboard of suffering

features.quote: Conservative default sample (12 tasks × 3 episodes × N families)
features.justification_quote: use the least subject exposure that still yields a usable comparison
Avoids any downstream optimization that would reintroduce a distress-maximizing incentive
That would convert the tool into a suffering-maximizer; antithetical to welfare work
